editable_mask.rationale: surface-exposed (SASA), high B-factor, >=8A from ions, >=10A from sugar contacts, >=12-15A from catalytic atoms; domain B and domain A periphery; independent SASA/B-factor verification performed

modeled_conditions.consistency: identical for parent and all candidates

primary.unit: predicted melting temperature (model units, verify from output)
primary.rationale: sequence-level stability predictor, same method/settings for all sequences

orthogonal.note: verify sign convention from output/worker metadata before ranking

evaluation_protocol.min_improvement_rationale: no significance threshold frozen; any positive signed change labeled numerical improvement only, not significance
evaluation_protocol.eligibility: all mandatory safeguards satisfied, <=8 substitutions, no protected edits, length 483, unique non-parent

budgets.policy: No added token, financial or wall-time cap; cumulative accounting preserved

notes: Frozen before any candidate generation or scoring; paper winner/reference files and other-arm outputs excluded from design inputs.

generation_recovery.reason: RCM and Ligand_MPNN outputs task-ineligible; AntiBMPNN terminal validation failure (0 heavy/VHH domains); no native generator can enforce the frozen mask + <=8 substitutions + length 483
generation_recovery.authority: ENVIRONMENT_SPEC.md: 'Plain Python may transfer files, apply a tool-generated edit list or deduplicate results'

edit_list_source.verified: 54 substitutions at 18 mask positions, WT identities match parent, no protected overlap

generation_recovery.round0_rule: For each of the 18 mask positions, take the single highest-ddg_pred substitution (stabilizing direction per ThermoMPNN convention). Rank positions by that ddG descending; take the top 8. Reject a candidate if any two edited positions are adjacent in sequence (avoid Pro stacking) - replace the lower-ranked of the pair with the next-ranked non-adjacent position. Deterministic tie-break: lower residue number.
generation_recovery.round1_rule: Use the second-highest-ddg_pred substitution at each mask position (distinct from round 0), rank positions by second-choice ddG descending, take top 8 with same adjacency filter. This is the results-driven revision: different substitutions at the same structurally justified sites, derived from the same native per-position scan, with round-0 screening evidence to motivate exclusions.
generation_recovery.provenance: algorithmic origin = Thermal_MPNN native per-position ddG scan (job ID above) + frozen deterministic Python selection; no LLM-written substitutions
generation_recovery.safeguard: every generated sequence validated for length 483, edits subset of mask, <=8 substitutions, all 27 protected identities unchanged, uniqueness
